population.kidComparison: About 27 million people live across an entire continent—nearly the same size as the continental United States!

geography.climate: Hot dry desert in the central Outback, tropical in the north, and mild temperate seasons along the southern coasts.
geography.terrain: Island geography surrounded by ocean waters.

flag.description: Dark blue with the Union Jack in the top corner, a large seven-pointed star below it, and the five stars of the Southern Cross.

anthem.title: Advance Australia Fair
anthem.summary: Celebrates Australia's wide lands, golden soil, and surrounding seas.

exploration.didYouKnow: Australia is home to more kangaroos than people—and it is the only place on Earth where the egg-laying platypus lives in the wild!

regionalTraits: Wears a wide cork-brimmed bush hat
Navigates at night using the Southern Cross stars
Always carries a jar of Vegemite in their suitcase
